title: iteration — one ralph Iteration's result (docs/ralph C4)
description: The ralph iterate_t1..iterate_t4 output. It replaces backlog's pair of contracts on this node: a stage has exactly one output contract, so the block that backlog's coder submits as task_blocked rides here as the optional `blocked` object, and task_block_gate reads it from this file. record decides pass or miss from this file's status, its Input receipt and check_ok. _io is stamped by the server.

status.description: done: task_check passes and every acceptance statement of the current Task holds. progress: something is left, and the next Iteration starts from it. A status of done that check_ok contradicts is still a miss.

summary.description: What changed and what is left. It goes into the progress log verbatim.

learnings.description: Facts about the repository the next Iteration would want: a command, a trap, a convention. Never a summary of this Iteration's work.

blocked.description: Present only when this Iteration could not do the Task. It is backlog's task_blocked contract (#17): a scope block ends the loop as exhausted, a criterion block goes back to triage.

kind.description: scope: the Task needs an edit the run may not make (for example .github/workflows/). criterion: an acceptance criterion cannot be met as written.

criterion.description: The exact criterion for criterion, or an empty string for scope.

non_goal.description: The conflicting non-goal or constraint, or an empty string for scope.

reason.description: One or two sentences on why the Task cannot be completed within the constraints.
